payload.description_html:
Tinapang Salinas (dried fish industry - Tamban, en:Sardinella and Herring) of Rosario, formerly Salinas, Cavite is the place where smoked fish called Tinapang Salinas originates. Tinapa Festival is held every month of October. Rosario is the foremost producer of agricultural products specifically smoked fish in the Philippines and named as the Smoked Fish Capital of Cavite. Ligtong geographical coordinates: 14° 25' 38" North, 120° 52' 15" East.
From Bulacan at 9:35 a.m., I took photo of the Baliuag Transit Original station, and at 11:38 a.m., the en:5th Avenue LRT Station; then I arrived at Rosario and captured Noveleta Battle bridge at 2:08 pm, and then the Salinas Town or Rosario at 2:33 pm and finished photography at 7:04 pm. I arrived at Bulacan at 11:30 pm after 4+ hours of travel by bus, and started uploading via slow internet at 11:40 pm.
